from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,sys
b=Path.home()/'sponge-sim'/'pi3b_600mhz_swapguard_v2'
l=json.loads((b/'lock.json').read_text())
old=b.with_name('pi3b_600mhz')
for n in l['inputs']+[l['weights']]:
 (b/n).symlink_to(old/n)
hashes={}
for r in l['files']:
 p=b/r['name']; h=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert h==r['sha256'],r['name']
 hashes[r['name']]=h
sys.path.insert(0,str(b))
import control
snapshot=control.System().snapshot()
control.validate_snapshot(snapshot)
import numpy,scipy,psutil
print(json.dumps(dict(source_and_inputs_verified=hashes,lock_sha256=hashlib.sha256((b/'lock.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),snapshot=snapshot,versions=dict(numpy=numpy.__version__,scipy=scipy.__version__,psutil=psutil.__version__),no_model_import=True)))
